state_change_proposals: The 306th: THE PASS — a hundred strides; stream-bed floor; west scree to a shelf two-thirds up (the rig: a dead pine over a stacked shelf, roped; a SECOND stack at the far end); east wall sheer. The team: nine seen (more unseen); three crossbows; hoods; Compact kit. Broke along the ridge EAST over the far mouth; none taken; no faces; unlocated.

EXCHANGES: (1) silent entry; first volley at twenty strides; Vastin's plane at a SLANT facing the shelf, scree to rock; bolts skip; Brom's forearm (first volley, before the wall; the bolt drawn backward; bound before the third volley). (2) the pine cut at the fourth volley; the fall down the plane's face piled BEHIND — the west mouth closed (stone to a man's height, the pine on top); 'Held.' / 'Held.' (3) the swept scree; Seln up it unseen; the wall buying the climb; the broad man hit in the shoulder at the plane's foot-line (fifth volley), down outside it; THE YOUNG ONE stepped one stride out to drag him back and the sixth volley took him through the chest; Oryn's hands on him; nothing done; the broad man said his name (Cael did not enter it). (4) Seln over the lip at the seventh volley with the weighted cord; Cael up the bare scree — the THIRTEENTH's first use: palm on the second stack's brace, the line found ('his — not Teague's'), the stack sent ALONG the shelf; the RECOIL stopped in the RIBS (the marsh's ribs), 'once, plainly'; Teague up the stair LEFT-HANDED (a stave and its man a body's length back); the tall woman's spear reversed; Lira on the shelf with the flat; the team broke; Seln let the corded man go.

COSTS: the young one DEAD; Brom's forearm (through; bound); the broad man's shoulder (a bolt; bound by the other healer); Cael's RIBS (the thirteenth's recoil; 'the ribs wanted him to walk and not to bend'); Vastin spent to the stream-bed (day 27) — Karis sat beside him with her bound hand on his shoulder (unprecedented); Oryn's hands came off a person with nothing done, the first time.

TEAGUE'S LESSON verbatim (to the stone): 'A wall keeps everyone behind it. And one of mine wasn't.' He knelt by his dead as he reads a job. Oryn stood three strides back, kit closed, did not look away.

The doctrine said once to Teague's four at the fire; the young one 'nodded as the young nod' — Cael's entry, reread that night 'the heaviest line on the page'. The tall woman's first words to the six: 'And then?'

Cael at the far mouth: the site a half-day across a hazed plain; 'what it was drawn in was not ink and never had been'; 'he did not want it to be'. The west mouth is CLOSED — the crew goes on east; the mule was tied at the west mouth: RECOVERED? — must be resolved in Ch22 (the mule and Karis's boxes were at the west mouth outside the fall; Seln/Lira go round by the ridge to bring it; or the fall is climbed).
